limitations: This is a readback audit of preserved emulator evidence, not a human audit or a new execution.
M1 hang capture preserves timed_out:true and raw_qemu_exit:null; no numeric child kill status is invented.
Historical source identity is bound by recorded source fingerprints and copied artifact hashes, not by an independently rebuilt toolchain.
No physical hardware, host power loss, app routing behavior or production safety is established.
